# TEMPEST Operation Reference

Official request/response operations exposed by the standard DARTWIC engine and TEMPEST core.

Plugin-defined operations are extension points and are not official DARTWIC operations. Driver operations are currently descoped and are not included.

This source revision contains **94 official operations** and **2 explicitly excluded engine bindings**. The driver bridge is excluded because: Driver runtime operations are descoped from the official engine reference.
